body.p: Status of the Claims
Claims 1-16 are pending in the application, and all claims stand rejected. Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration and allowance of the claims. Claim Objections
The Office Action objects to claim 1 on the grounds that it is not clear where the preamble
ends due to a lack of an explicit transitional phrase. Applicant has amended claim 1 in a manner that is believed to make this objection is moot. Rejections Under 35 U.S.C. § 103

Claims 1-4, 6 and 10-16 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over EP 2,179,746 ("Burger" in view of US 3,544,146 ("Asenbauer"). Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration and withdrawal of this rejection.
Claim 1 recites a filter covering having a plate that extends in a main plane, and two clip portions that are bent away from the main plane. In addition:

wherein in a sectional view of the filter covering viewed along the main plane in which the at least two clip portions are provided, an entire section of the filter covering except for the at least two clip portions extends in the main plane, and the at least two clip portions bend away from the main plane in the bracket- or C-shaped manner such that respective ends of the clip portions face each other such that said respective ends of the clip portions are located closer to each other than respective portions of the
two clip portions adjacent the ends.

An example of this structure is shown in Figures 2 and 3 of Applicant's disclosure, which are reproduced in annotated form below for the Examiner's convenience. As best shown in Figure 3, the entire portion of the filter covering 8 having a sectional view in which the clip portions 12 are provided (enclosed in dashed lines) extends in the main plane defined by the upper plate, and the clip portions extend away from the main plane in a bracket- or C-shaped manner.

Asenbauer discloses a box lid 12 having a lid flange 32 to which lid clips 14 are attached. As best shown in Asenbauer's Figure 2, the lid flange 32 is offset downwardly from the main plane of the lid. The lid clips 14 extend downward from the lid flange 32, and thus are even further offset from the main plane of the lid.

In both Burger and Asenbauer, in a sectional view in which the at least two clip portions are provided, the entire section of the filter covering does not extend in the main plane with the exception of the at least two clip portions. Rather, in each case, the filter covering is bent away from any comparable main plane at various locations. Thus, the combination of Burger and Asenbauer does not teach or suggest each and every element of claim 1.
Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration and withdrawal of the rejection of claim 1 and all claims depending therefrom for at least the foregoing reasons.

Claims 5 and 7-9 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Burger in view of Asenbauer and US 7,595,032 ("Banks"). Banks does not cure the failure of the base combination to teach each and every element of claim 1, and thus Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration and withdrawal of the rejection of claims 5 and 7-9. New Claims
New claims 17-20 are added to each recite subject matter that also is not taught or suggested by the cited art.

New claim 17 recites "wherein each of said respective ends of the clip portions is clip portion end having a maximum distance from the main plane." Support for new claim 17 is provided in Figure 3 of Applicant's disclosure, in which the lowermost ends of the side portions 24 of the clips are located at a maximum distance from the main plane. No new matter is added. None of the cited art teaches this feature. Burger teaches snap connectors 33, 34 having ends that are located closer to the main plane than other parts of the structure. Similarly, Asenbauer teaches lid clips 14 having legs 28 extending further from the main plane than the ends of the clip portions. Banks also does not disclose any comparable structure.

New claim 18 recites "wherein a 'C' is formed between each of said respective ends of the clip portions and the main plane in the sectional view." Support for new claim 18 is provided in Figure 3 of Applicant's disclosure, in which the clips define C shapes. No new matter is added. Neither Burger nor Asenbauer teaches this feature. In Burger, the snap connectors 33, 34 are hook- shaped, and in Asenbauer the lid clips 14 are square-shaped. Banks also does not disclose any comparable structure.

New claim 19 recites "wherein each of said respective ends of the clip portions ends at a downward angle extending away from the main plane." Support for new claim 19 is provided in Figure 3 of Applicant's disclosure, in which the lowermost ends of the side portions 24 of the clips are oriented at an angle that extends down away from the main plane. No new matter is added. None of the cited art teaches or suggests this feature. Burger shows snap connectors that terminate
in an upward hook, and Asenbauer shows connectors having a lip 42 that extends towards the top of the lid. Banks does not have any comparable structure.

New claim 20 recites "wherein the plate extends in the main plane from a first edge at which a first one of the at least two clip portions is located to a second edge at which a second one of the at least two clip portions is located, and an entirety of the filter covering between the first edge and the second edge extends in the main plane." Support for new claim 20 is provided in Figure 3 of Applicant's disclosure, in which the plate defining the upper plane of the filter covering 8 is entirely flat between the edges where the clip portions 12 are located (in other places, protrusions, shown in broken lines but not labeled, optionally may extend down to maintain an air gap). No new matter is added. None of the cited art teaches or suggests this feature. Burger shows the cover having a circumferential lip surrounding the flat middle region, Asenbauer teaches a box lid that has a sidewall and shelf 30 that that extend downwardly from all sides of the flat upper region, and Banks shows a cover 37 having a filter recess 37 surrounding the entire flat middle region.
Thus, combination of cited art does not teach or suggest each and every element of claims 17-20, and applicant respectfully requests favorable consideration and allowance of these claims.
